summary: Use Crossref updated-by when deciding whether a checked paper was retracted, keep expressions of concern separate, and return a failing status after a structured lookup error.
reason: Crossref update-to points from a notice toward the work it updates, so treating it as evidence that the notice itself was retracted creates a false verdict. Expressions of concern do not establish retraction, and a JSON error verdict should not exit successfully.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests cover Crossref update direction, an expression of concern, separate scan counts, and nonzero exit status with parseable JSON on a failed check.
